page.overview:
Who is Darth Quellus?

Darth Quellus was a Dark Lord of the Sith who served the Sith Empire. The Sith Lord was dispatched as an emissary to Aaloth, a Twi'lek colony alongside his Sith minions to conquer the planet. According to folklore, he used the dark side to curse their candles to literally burn black. This curse was so potent, that even the sun was blackened. Eventually, Quellus was forced to escape on his starship when he suffered burn injuries.
